description: This file defines the interface ManufacturerDao which extends a generic DAO interface to provide data access methods specific to Manufacturer entities, including listing manufacturers by store, counting products attached to a manufacturer, and listing by category IDs.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturers associated with a specific store and language.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturers for a specific store without specifying language.

methods.name: getCountManufAttachedProducts
methods.description: Returns the count of products attached to a specific manufacturer.
